name: list_cards
description: List the cheat sheet: the grammar pages' cards (one per page: hand-written ones marked), the curated cards no page fits and yours (id, title, level, grammar pages), the tutor messages Jan pinned, the cards Jan opens most (a count that halves every two weeks), and looked_up: the grammar pages Jan looked up during exercises in the last two weeks (n: the answers given with one of its cards open; last: the latest day), most first.
